title: [finding] Qualify the last present-tense paths-ignore twins together: check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts:739 + check-action-forward-parity.test.ts:712
body:
Follow-up recorded by the PM seat from #4381 / PR #4382's exceptions list, filed so the pair isn't lost. Filed unassigned.

## Fact

PR #4382's closing sweep graded and deliberately left two near-verbatim twin comments, the last unqualified present-tense `paths-ignore` texts in the repo:

- `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts:739` — was a held surface at sweep time (#3878 trio, PR #4378 — **now landed**, hold lifted)
- `scripts/__tests__/check-action-forward-parity.test.ts:712` — free at sweep time, left so the pair would not be split into disagreeing shapes

Both assert that `ci.yml` paths-ignores a pattern list and conclude their PR class always starts the workflow. Per #4382's grading: the **conclusion is true today** (more strongly so — nothing filters pull requests by path at all), and the premise is accurate about the surviving `push` list, so neither is in the "decide by it, decide wrong" class that drove #3857/#4369/#4381. This is a qualification pass (mark the premise as `push`-scoped / historical, per the corrected dialect of PRs #4371/#4380/#4382), not a falsehood fix — which is why it's a `finding` and not `pm:queue`.

## Constraint

The two must move **together in one PR** — fixing either alone recreates the two-shapes split the family existed to end. Comment-only, assertions untouched, the #4382 mechanical proof pattern applies.

## Dispatch gate

Wait until no in-flight task holds the i18n gate test surface (at filing time, the #4375+#4376 pair is in flight on packages/i18n — its scope shouldn't touch these two files, but verify at claim time).

Related: #3857 / PR #4371, #4369 / PR #4380, #4381 / PR #4382 (whose exceptions list is the source of this card).
